articles.title: Americans hit with record-high Labor Day Weekend gasoline prices - CNBC
articles.description: The national average gasoline price will probably hit $4.03 on Labor Day, topping the record $3.83 per gallon set in 2012, said GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan.
